scope: Actual fresh GP editor loads while the physical VM/HTTP soak was active

loads.label: soak-01
loads.note: Per-poll Runtime.evaluate could block behind GP initialization and let the event ring overflow. Independent Resource Timing verified all52 successful responses. The later collector drains events without evaluating during bootstrap.

observation: The delivered eight-client HTTP configuration did not pass the combined fresh-browser plus VM/asset workload. The VM soak also timed out after seven complete cycles. Original CRCs and allocator pools were recovered without resetting the board.
followup: Increase the bounded service pool to12 clients and network contexts to32, add WebSocket diagnostics/short-send detection, and repeat the complete30-minute test. Do not treat this record as PASS.
